comment: Canonical series catalog. One row per (concept, geography, entity) identity; uuid is minted once and never re-minted (regeneration preserves it by identity, then by concept/alias). Consumers reference series by uuid or concept only. Regenerate with scripts/build_series_catalog.py; verify with --check. Cross-spelling and cross-vintage merges are manual curation: keep the surviving row's uuid, move absorbed spellings to aliases — curated aliases persist across regeneration. Aliases listed in ambiguous_aliases match multiple rows and never drive identity inheritance.
